verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for any locally installed CLI tool, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any switch to disable them. The self-contained binary note (pandoc-docs-29) is about packaging, not data collection, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
